<h1>Install, restore and watch agent skills from the command line.</h1>
<p>One native CLI pins where each skill comes from and installs it for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and OpenCode.</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/skill-cli/cli/blob/master/Documentation/Reference/CLI.md">Documentation</a> · <a href="https://github.com/skill-cli/cli/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md">Contributing</a> · <a href="https://github.com/skill-cli/cli/blob/master/SECURITY.md">Security</a> · <a href="https://github.com/skill-cli/cli/blob/master/SUPPORT.md">Support</a></p>
</div>

### Get started

```sh
brew install skill-cli/tap/skill-cli
skill add owner/repo --skill name
skill install
```

### Manage skills

<table>
<tr><td><strong><a href="https://github.com/skill-cli/cli">cli</a></strong><br>The <code>skill</code> command: add skills from local paths, Git repositories or well-known indexes, pin them, restore installs and review watched sources.</td></tr>
</table>
